hypothesis: The ancient authenticity apparatus — Pinakes with incipit and stichometric checksum, the obelus, the nothos/antilegomena vocabulary, transmission of corpora WITH their disputes — is the OUTPUT of working on a calibration object, not evidence against one. Criteria must be fitted to a case whose answer is known.
explains: the corpus is instrumented against itself and the instrumentation is preserved
M11's circularity becomes the datum rather than a defect in the measurement
M30's naming-gap reflex reads as cataloguer's discipline — an unnamed class is unshelvable
the Poetics' unnamed-genre problem is a cataloguer's problem, not an aesthetic one
danger_stated_in_document: It explains everything including every null. Both hypotheses predict the Pinakes. Section 4 exists so the property is visible and arguable rather than doing silent work.
discriminating_asymmetry: An instrument built on a calibration object OVERFITS it. Criteria derived from this corpus should fit it better than corpora they were later applied to.

test.measured_over: the history of judgements, not the texts — counts verdicts rather than measuring similarity, so none of the five broken nulls applies
components: verdict decisiveness — proportion with a STATED GROUND
test.kill_condition: fails unless Plato-Aristotle exceeds comparisons on at least component 2, decisiveness; no post-hoc reweighting
test.void_condition: survival is confounded with attention; if no defensible normalisation by citation volume can be constructed the test is VOID and reported void, per EA-LEAK-DEFICIT-02 precedent

positive_would_not_license: Design. Centrality and construction predict the same overfitting — the Platonic-Aristotelian corpus was the largest, earliest and most institutionally central prose body, and criteria would be worked out on it for that reason alone.

corrections.prediction_backwards: registered overfitting; adversarial object predicts failure-to-converge instead
corrections.feasibility_not_checked_before_registrat: 4 of 5 comparison traditions unreachable; DL alone has 48 markers total
corrections.substitute_design_also_fails: method-disagreement needs a consistent baseline; agreement on knowns is 1/3
corrections.precondition_exposed: the instrument set is UNVALIDATED — no measure was scored on known-status pairs before use

disposition: DEFERRED on unavailable sources; framing superseded by EA-FLOOD-01; no new registration until a validation suite exists
